text: 設計樣式跟功能很棒，但是放在手機桌面的小工具無法直接進入app，也沒辦法進行完成事項的勾選，不確定是不是只有我遇到此問題
author: 路過
developer_reply: Thank you for your feedback! We’ve disabled opening the app from the home screen widget because trying to tap the small checkbox can cause accidental app launches. The home screen widget currently only shows incomplete tasks. We’ll improve this in a future update by adding an option to show completed tasks.
